info.title: Parksical API contract
info.description: Mixed implemented/design contract. Development auth, vehicle metadata, synthetic lot management, authenticated catalog search/detail and versioned difficulty are implemented. Reviews/aggregates are disabled by default and require explicit non-production synthetic development opt-in. No production deployment, real collection/anonymization approval, actual SDK validation or physical parkability assessment is claimed. S-09 private positions/history and transactional normalized photos require explicit non-production synthetic opt-in; D-02/D-06 operation policies remain pending. S-10 QR/phone flow is explicit non-production opt-in, provisional D-07; /p#token avoids token-bearing server paths, one-time explicit exchange and issuer-bound phone session expire at original 24h deadline. S-12 mission catalog/runs/results are explicit non-production SYNTHETIC development opt-in. Frozen rule/structure/stage versions and immutable terminal results; consistency is not physical verification. D-02/D-04 pending; operationalAllowed/rankingEligible/rewardEligible remain false. S-13 synthetic PRACTICE reports/comparison, versioned three-perfect-run qualification and stable/revocable stamp/title projection are implemented-development. Optional gearTransitionCount preserves older result payloads. See practice.md; no raw trajectory/real collection/operational challenge/ranking/reward approval.

get.description: WEB or VEHICLE bearer; active SYNTHETIC catalog only. No occupancy, geocoding, verified discount eligibility or MAX availability. Synthetic navigation coordinates have usable=false. No-store; session limit 300 reads/5 min. See docs/lot-search.md. Radius defaults to 3000m (1..20000), or all four bounds (non-wrapping, diagonal <=40km and each axis <=1 degree). Origin latitude/longitude always required. Distance is unrounded spherical Haversine metres, R=6371008.8. EASIEST uses difficulty-v1 unroundedScore null-last, ties by distance then UUID. At most 1000 matching current lots; excess returns 422 SEARCH_TOO_BROAD. Cursor binds normalized query/year and catalog versions; changed catalog returns 409 SEARCH_CHANGED. Unknown fields/malformed pairs are 400. Listed discounts are conditions, not eligibility. S-08 optional synthetic review aggregate metadata. Default disabled preserves prior calculation; explicit opt-in uses stored same-version reviews, count<5 excluded and score withheld. No actual collection/anonymization approval. Aggregate version changes invalidate search cursor.

Same token/browser proof/key retry restores same HttpOnly credential and returns Idempotency-Replayed:true without storing raw secrets. Other browser/key after consumption409 QR_ALREADY_EXCHANGED. Same original grant deadline, never extended from exchange. Unknown/expired/revoked/deleted/issuer-unlinked410 QR_UNAVAILABLE. No account access.

Limit1..50(default20), cursor binds owner/kind/installation/limit. Live comparison uses immediately preceding non-invalidated COMPLETED attempt in same cohort; missing counts remain null. Live progress for the anchor run cohort: owner+installation+lot+structureVersion+missionRule+ordered stage snapshot+goalVersion. Three consecutive complete all-3-star stages qualify. Occurrence startedAt ASC/UUID ASC, not receipt time. ACTIVE, invalidated, failed, abort and unverifiable break streak. Later failures do not erase a valid earlier triple; late records/invalidation can revoke that triple. Refreshes legacy persisted projection under same user transaction lock. Recommendation is a stage-count test policy, not certified physical difficulty or operational permission.

parkingSpaces.description: Omitted = not mapped; [] = mapped but none. COMPLETE requires explicit arrays and at least one parking space. Whole JSON request remains limited to 64KiB.

pillars.description: Omitted = not mapped; [] = mapped but none. COMPLETE requires explicit arrays and at least one parking space. Whole JSON request remains limited to 64KiB.

driveAisles.description: Explicit free-space drive corridors. COMPLETE requires connected aisles and approach geometry for every space.

AdminLotSnapshot.description: Versioned structure with individual bays, protected pillar islands, connected drive aisles and unobstructed approach rectangles. Checks are planar geometric checks, not car-specific swept-path, building-code or ramp design approval.

ParkingSpace.description: Structural space, not sensed occupancy. Heading is counterclockwise from local +x toward vehicle front; units degrees. Dimensions are authored synthetic values, not legal/safety certification.

SpaceApproach.description: Clear rectangular approach from the specified bay edge, not a collision-free vehicle trajectory. Depth must be at least the referenced aisle width. Entire area must avoid other bays/pillar islands, enter the same-floor/zone aisle and remain inside the zone.

DifficultyRule.description: Immutable difficulty-v1 development heuristic. Rule weights/minimum coverage use percent; result normalized weights use fractions. Uncalibrated, not a safety or parkability assessment.

dataBase64.description: Canonical padded base64 only. Decoded input max2MiB, JPEG/PNG magic and actual decode, max12MP. Re-encoded metadata-free JPEG <=2048x2048, <=2MiB. JSON photo route only3MiB; others64KiB.

MissionStageMetrics.description: Optional gearTransitionCount is an app-local synthetic count of changes between valid selected-gear samples, excluding the initial observation; unknown or unsupported is null/omitted. Never inferred from reverseSegmentCount. Added in 0.11.0; unchanged required fields allow older clients.
